elements.text:
A group of your friends are talking about getting allowance from their parents. Your parents can't afford to give you an allowence, and you have to work a job after school to make money. 

Here are some thoughts that might pop into mind:

texts: My situation is different from my friends', but different doesn't mean worse.
I worry that my friends would judge me if they knew the truth, but I don't actually have evidence they would.
My family is an embarrassment compared to everyone else's.
I'm building real work experience and responsibility that most people my age don't have yet.
Part of me wants to resent my parents for putting me in this position, but I know they're doing their best.
